selected_script.angle: A smart 2-in-1 kitchen space-saver that secretly hides a spray bottle inside the paper towel holder, eliminating countertop clutter.
selected_script.hook: I bet you didn't know this stylish matte black paper towel holder has a secret feature hidden right inside.

segment_01.voiceover: I bet you didn't know this stylish matte black paper towel holder has a secret feature hidden right inside. Watch what happens when I push the top.
segment_01.visual: Mid shot of creator showing a sleek matte black paper towel holder on a clean kitchen counter. She pushes the button on the top and pulls out a hidden spray bottle.

segment_02.voiceover: It houses a hidden spray bottle inside the heavy, weighted base stand. Just pop it out to wipe down spills instantly, without cluttering the counter.
segment_02.visual: Close-up of the transparent spray bottle spraying water on the counter. The creator slides it back into the solid black rod, locking it perfectly.

segment_03.voiceover: The weighted base stays rock-solid while the tension arm lets you tear one-handed. Clean countertops are that simple. Grab yours today!
segment_03.visual: A hand pulling and tearing a paper towel sheet effortlessly with one hand using the tension arm, showing the heavy base remains stable without tipping.

broll_coverage.visual: Close-up functional B-roll: pressing the lock, pulling out the spray bottle, misting the surface, and inserting it back into the solid matte black sleeve.
